title: Joomla content planner: the model gets a slot's words and limits, not the page list or where Joomla stores the value
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/plan-joomla-contract.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines, and whether the test 'the model is shown what it needs to write a slot, and nothing of where Joomla stores it' is 'ok'.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 19); the named test is 'ok': no page list in the model input, no JSON path, XPath, nested-JSON name or site-identity flag on a slot, `current` only when it differs from `sample`, `requiresEvidence` only when true, the element of an XPath slot kept.
evidence: 05/10/2026 local stand, planning tracy-business/j6/1.2.0 for one language as Apply does: 25 model calls carried 491k characters, 164k of them the same 78-page list in every call; 138.8k prompt tokens per plan. After the fix: 224.6k characters, 66.7k prompt tokens (median of 6 real runs, -52%), slots written 482 -> 514 (median), no demo words in written values (tasks/evidence/add-site-apply-audit/joomla-planner-tokens.md).
fence: Only what the model is shown changes; which slots are planned, how answers are judged and what reaches the site do not.
